articles.title: Video Game Movies Are Having a Big Year
articles.summary: Game films drew big crowds in 2026, and studios are planning many more, including Elden Ring, Zelda, and a PUBG series.

articles.title: Godzilla Stars Get Big Cheers in Tokyo
articles.summary: The stars of Godzilla Minus Zero remembered the nonstop clapping and fan chants in Los Angeles at the Tokyo festival, just before the film opens in Japan.

articles.title: Harriet Dart Reaches Her First Big Final
articles.summary: Harriet Dart beat Sun Xinran in three sets at the Guangzhou Open to reach her first WTA Tour singles final. She will play Lilli Tagger on Sunday.
